**Source:** Privacy Value Model V4 + Acts XXI–XXII (Hitchhiker's Gambit & Hoopy Frood)   **Target context:** Community builders, DAO architects, creative commons governance designers, guide-based education platforms, cooperative IP management   **Architecture:** [agentprivacy.ai](https://agentprivacy.ai) · **Sync:** [sync.soulbis.com](https://sync.soulbis.com) · **Contact:** mage@agentprivacy.ai

The Hitchhiker's Infrastructure is a governance pattern for distributed creative projects that cannot be bought, only joined.
